reviews.reasons: The ledger arithmetic is right and the downside is small ($30 owner cash, max exposure $184 inside the $1,000 cap), but the plan is not yet a CONDITIONAL plan the owner should act on. (1) The proof gate does not imply the target: passing on 'at least 2 prepaid shops from ~300 emails by day 12' measures a ~0.7% purchase rate, at which the same 300 contacts yield ~2 shops, not 9; the continue rule ('keep sending until 9 have paid by day 18') needs ~1,000+ further contacts that no step, sending capacity or buyer count supports. Reaching 9 from 300 needs a 3% cold-email-to-$750-prepay rate inside 18 days; the gate should be set at that rate (or the volume and sending capacity planned and shown) so that passing it actually predicts $6,000. (2) Every fact on the SEO card is RECOMMENDATION; no link is established. validation.decides names only CONVERSION and OFFER_AND_PRICE, yet the plan also rests on unknowns that research, not a live test, can answer and that the decides list omits: MARKET_VOLUME (the card's 41,805 is a RECOMMENDATION, and the 300 Google-Maps shops are uncounted), FULFILMENT and ECONOMICS (a local-SEO specialist at $300 fixed per client is unsourced; the gate tests it but it is not declared decisive), and CURRENT_DEMAND (an agency serving the industry is not a buying signal).
